data.one_liner: Renders Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG 1.1) and precompiled vector graphics in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: flutter_svg parses and displays SVG 1.1 vector graphics directly inside Flutter widget trees from assets, network URLs, strings, or files. It allows tinting, custom color mapping, and manual rendering to a Canvas or ui.Image. It also supports loading precompiled binary vector graphics (.vec) generated by the vector_graphics_compiler for improved runtime performance.
use_when: Rendering SVG files from local assets, memory strings, or network endpoints.
Displaying resolution-independent vector icons and illustrations without raster scaling artifacts.
Manipulating SVG colors programmatically via color filters or ColorMapper rules.
avoid_when: Handling raster image formats like PNG, JPEG, or WebP without any SVG requirements.
Working with complex SVGs requiring full CSS styling or unsupported advanced SVG features.
strengths: Supports multiple input sources including asset, network, string, and raw byte loaders.
Integrates with vector_graphics for ahead-of-time precompilation and faster parsing.
Provides granular color remapping via the ColorMapper interface and colorFilter properties.
weaknesses: CSS support is limited, requiring presentation attributes instead of inline CSS for best compatibility.
Complex SVG features or improper configurations may fail to render as expected compared to standard web browsers.

alternatives.name: extended_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick extended_image when handling raster images requiring zooming, caching, panning, and crop tools rather than vector SVG rendering.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick octo_image when you need advanced placeholder, error, and progress indicator mechanics for raster images.
